column1: # Skill DB Type, NoDamage, Ignore damage flags and ammunition for every catalog
# skill, both modes. Extracted from the reference skill database (renewal and
# pre-renewal) at the pinned reference commit. Columns: id, name, renewal type,
# renewal no_damage, pre-renewal type, pre-renewal no_damage, renewal ignore
# flags, pre-renewal ignore flags, renewal ammo types, renewal ammo amounts,
# pre-renewal ammo types, pre-renewal ammo amounts. The ignore flags column
# lists the set ones among IgnoreDefCard, IgnoreElement and IgnoreFlee ("none"
# when none is set). The ammo types column lists the `Requires: Ammo` subtypes
# ("none" when the row requires none); the ammo amounts column is the per-level
# `AmmoAmount` sequence, one entry per level ("0,0,..." when no level requires
# ammunition, which is also what a type declared without an amount means). Every
# column is "-" when the mode has no row.
